headline: Iran War Odds Through 2026
status: Saudi authorities say Saturday's Houthi strike on Riyadh airport killed 12 and injured 309, the deadliest yet on the Saudi front. A US jet disabled a Panama-flagged cargo ship running the blockade from an Iranian port, an enforcement action rather than a strike on Iran, and the IRGC's supertanker mine claim is still unconfirmed. No tripwire fired and odds are unchanged; war by Nov. 3 stays at 55%.
